title: Smart Home Dash
blurb: Route spoken commands to the right smart home device.
lesson: Routing a short command to one of a few options is what Jev does fast and cheaply.
why: Each voice command is one Choice question over six devices. Jev returns the device with a probability, so every command is routed in a single quick call.
A racer scores when it picks the device that should handle the command. Vague commands such as "make it brighter" are the hard ones.
